messages:
Alex M: Heads-up — I want to push kernel-engine v3.1.0 (quant ABI bump) to canary tonight but not as a hard swap. Proposal: enable a 'safe_mode' nonblocking flag that routes mismatched quant kernels to legacy path and emits telemetry. Keeps traffic flowing without full rollback.
Mira R: +1 for safe_mode. Can we make it opt-in per-cluster? some regions have older drivers.
Samir: Agree. Also need to pin the quant build artifact separately from the kernel image so we can swap one without touching the other.
Alex M: Plan sketch:
- Create feature flag runtime.safe_mode=true (default OFF)
- Start canary with flag ON for 2% of traffic (night window)
- Telemetry: latency, p50/p95, kv-cache hit rate, error rate, token cost delta
- If any metric regresses >5% over baseline for 15m -> auto-throttle to 0.5% then rollback full image
Jen: Sounds good. How does deploybot interact? Do we need a new guard in the deploy pipeline?
deploy-bot: deploy initiated: rolling runtime-engine:v3.1.0 -> canary groups [night-bucket-1]
Opsbot: NOTE: upcoming infra change on 1917658000 (driver patch) in ap-south. avoid region for canary.
Samir: Add a per-canary override so we can enable safe_mode in eu-west only. Example config:
```
canary:
  groups:
    - eu-west-1
  safe_mode: true
  traffic_pct: 2
```
Mira R: Telemetry hooks — add an event when codepath hits legacy-quant-fallback. We should also record model_id, sequence_len, and gpu_type.
Alex M: Agree. Also emit a short stack tag so we can trace regressions to kernels/quant build pair.
Jen: What are rollback criteria? auto and manual?
Samir: Auto: error rate spike >3x baseline OR p95 latency +30% sustained 10m -> auto-drag-down to 0.5% then pause. Manual: oncall can flip safe_mode=false + pin older kernel with one-line.
Alex M: Pin example command (for ops use):
```
./deployctl pin --service runtime-engine --image runtime-engine:v3.0.7 --reason "post-canary fallback"
```
runtime-oncall: Oncall ack. We'll watch dashboards and alert rules pre-configured. Set pager threshold: 5% increase in 5xx across any canary group.
Mira R: Also add a stealth metric for token-level correctness (few eval prompts run against canary). If quality drop >2% -> immediate hold.
Samir: Can we schedule the main rollout in 3 phases: night canary (2%), broad canary (10% next day), regional ramp (25% over 24h)?
Alex M: Yes. Also request a quick-release-notes blurb so SRE and support know about safe_mode and pinning commands.
Jen: I'll draft the release notes and add the change window: 02:00-04:00 UTC tonight. No marketing blast.
deploy-bot: canary rollout updated: groups=[eu-west-1], traffic=2%, flag=runtime.safe_mode ON
Opsbot: Reminder: confirm quant build checksum before broad canary. Use /artifacts checksum.
Alex M: Checksum verified: sha256: a3f5...b9c4
Mira R: Quick checklist before canary start:
- [x] safe_mode flag implemented
- [x] telemetry events wired
- [x] deploybot guard added
- [x] release notes drafted
- [ ] post-deploy smoke evals in place
Samir: I'll add the smoke evals now, expect them to be live in 15m.
runtime-oncall: We'll be standing by. If anything odd, flip safe_mode OFF to force legacy path, or run pin command.
Jen: Final: keep channel open during the night window. Ping @runtime-oncall for any alerts.
Alex M: Thanks everyone. Starting canary in ~20m.
